title: Paprika Recipe Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=paprika:recipe
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(recipe_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Paprika recipe events land each day and how many distinct recipe values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Paprika recipe records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct recipe values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much Paprika recipe activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
